stem.text: The vector diagram shows three coplanar forces acting on an object at P.

stem.alt: Vector diagram on a square grid with point P at the origin of three arrows: a 3N arrow pointing up, a 4N arrow pointing right, and a 4N arrow pointing down-left.

stem.text: The magnitude of the resultant of these three forces is $1\,\text{N}$.
What is the direction of this resultant force?

A.alt: Arrow pointing down and to the left.

B.alt: Arrow pointing down and to the right.

C.alt: Arrow pointing up and to the left.

D.alt: Arrow pointing up and to the right.
